description: Plant-and-recover benchmark: solved-page English enciphered under the soft anti-repeat rule (re-draw 0.81 on an output repeat) with the stated key, sign convention (sub: C=P+K; add: C=P-K; beaufort: C=K-P) and F variant (a plaintext F left unencrypted, consuming no key). A decoder should recover the plaintext from ciphertext + key_stream, and a sweep should rank the key first among its family. Runes are Gematria Primus indices 0-28 (F U TH O R C G W H N I J EO P X S T B E M L NG OE D A AE Y IA EA).
